# Nicholas Velten

> Software engineer building full-stack products, production automation, distributed workflows, and AI agent infrastructure.

Software engineer with five years building and operating production systems for Brazilian ISPs, currently at one of the country's largest fiber providers. My current domain is telecom, but the through-line is broader: full-stack delivery, distributed workflows, correctness under production pressure, safe reprocessing, service automation, and systems that fail quietly unless you know where to look.

## Agent-Readable Files

## Projects

- [Paperboy](https://nicholas-velten.xyz/paperboy): RSS reader and podcast player as your new tab
- [Arbitus](https://nicholas-velten.xyz/arbitus): Security proxy for AI agents and MCP servers
- [agent-memory](https://github.com/nfvelten/agent-memory): MCP server that turns an Obsidian vault into AI agent memory
- [Mate Creations](https://nicholas-velten.xyz/matecreations): Design system with a written spec, tokens and automated checks
- [keybinds-tui](https://github.com/harbefas/keybinds-tui): Terminal UI that reads live keybinding configuration instead of drifting from it
- [Amphora](https://nicholas-velten.xyz/amphora): Personal knowledge management system
- [Agent Code Buddy](https://nicholas-velten.xyz/agent-code-buddy): Mobile HITL companion for AI coding agents
- [Phone Development Deck](https://nicholas-velten.xyz/deck): Distributed dev platform across Arch Linux, Android/Termux and Kubernetes

## Writing

- [Creatures (1996) and the accidental invention of AI alignment problems](https://nicholas-velten.xyz/posts/creatures-norn-alignment): Reads the 1998 Creatures/Norns community as an early documented case of reward hacking, specification gaming and emergent misuse.
- [Auditing a PII exposure across a Java microservice stack](https://nicholas-velten.xyz/posts/pii-exposure-audit): Production security write-up.
- [MCP gateway](https://nicholas-velten.xyz/posts/mcp-gateway): Design argument behind Arbitus.
- [JDBC migration](https://nicholas-velten.xyz/posts/jdbc-migration): Engineering write-up from production migration work.
